reports.evidence: Dohkar’s hands froze mid-gesture. Every First Favored in the clearing felt the sour note at the same moment. I knew why before anyone else could name it. She had taken my unresolved wound and made it the stage for her virtue, and the wording was too loose to bind cleanly. Say it …

The Dohkar lifted his hands, and the clearing fell silent under the pale mated-pair trees. Seren knelt on the crimson spiralgrass, her aqua skin luminous with Weave-Script that showed only calm. She began the invocation the way we had rehearsed for months. Her voice was steady. “
